roles.description: Maintains the charter, invariants, frozen surface, schemas, decisions, research and audit records, release version, SPEC, and the root contract.
Owns work items and their lifecycle transitions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
Owns evidence run manifests and reproducibility records.
Owns the repopact package, validators, generators, conformance corpus, templates, tests, packaging, and CI automation.
Owns project-facing documentation, community files, examples, launch records, and the Diataxis set under docs/.

concurrency.note: When true, no two non-terminal (active/blocked) work items may share an owner or affected scope. Adopters with multiple concurrent agents should enable this.

preflight.note: Mandatory preflight (decision 0021): work items 023+ must record a preflight marker (the item was created before implementation began). Items 000-022 predate the 2.0 mandate and are grandfathered.
